newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Astra shares fall on Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Astra shares fall on Q1 results.

text.p: Swedish drugs major Astra shares fell on Monday after the company posted a lower than expected pre-tax profit for the first quarter of 1997.
At 1410 GMT Astra's shares was 7.5 crowns lower at 335 crowns. It was trading at 344 crowns before the company posted its results.
The share continued to fall and by 1430 GMT it was trading at 325.5, down 17 crowns but off a low of 323.5.
"Astra's report was not really as bad as the market reaction would indicate," said Ingemar Kihlstrom, pharmaceuticals analyst at Stockholm brokerage Aros.

"Sales were a bit worse than expected but not dramatically so. What we are seeing is a sharp reaction because the market was expecting a somewhat higher profit," she said. "In the long term Astra is an attractive share."
Analysts had forecast a Q1 pre-tax profit of 3.93 billion crowns, up on the 3.46 billion posted by the company.
